query:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS tobacco_landraces (
  id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
  name VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL,
  alternate_names VARCHAR(255),
  country VARCHAR(100),
  region VARCHAR(100),
  terroir_description TEXT,
  species VARCHAR(100) DEFAULT 'Nicotiana tabacum',
  genetic_origin TEXT,
  creation_period VARCHAR(100),
  status ENUM('active', 'rare', 'endangered', 'extinct', 'unknown') DEFAULT 'unknown',
  rarity_score INT,
  aromatic_profile TEXT,
  aromatic_intensity INT,
  dominant_notes TEXT,
  secondary_notes TEXT,
  indoles_ppm DECIMAL(10,2),
  terpenes_floraux_ppm DECIMAL(10,2),
  lactones_ppm DECIMAL(10,2),
  molecular_profile_type ENUM('cuir-animal', 'floral-mielle', 'cremeux-gourmand', 'mixte', 'unknown') DEFAULT 'unknown',
  data_certainty ENUM('confirmed', 'hypothetical', 'estimated') DEFAULT 'hypothetical',
  perfumery_potential_score DECIMAL(3,1),
  perfumery_applications TEXT,
  cultivation_notes TEXT,
  curing_method VARCHAR(100),
  historical_notes TEXT,
  source_references TEXT,
  created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  updated_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
);
